testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a feature appearance choice: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:731:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a feature appearance choice ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And an extrusion in the MCAD Software has Feature Appearance set to As Body ✔ When the user opens Feature Properties from its browser context menu ✔ And the user opens the Feature Appearance list ✔ Then the list offers As Body and named appearances including Black ✔ When the user chooses Black ✔ Then Feature Appearance shows Black ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties ✔ Then Feature Appearance shows As Body ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes and the solid remains visible
